# Branding test inputs

`brand-mark.svg` and the glyph geometry in `create-font.mjs` were written for this
repository and use its MIT license. `brand-font.ttf` is generated by that script.
The font intentionally draws synthetic glyphs; it tests coverage, metrics and
outline delivery, not typographic beauty. No system or commercial font is bundled.

Run the CLI from the repository root:

```sh
node dist/cli.js --logo-kit test/fixtures/brand-kit.json -o generated-images/fixture-kit
node dist/cli.js --brand-board test/fixtures/brand-board.json -o generated-images/fixture-board
```

These calls are offline. Visual typography checks use separately supplied static
font files, recorded with their family names and hashes in the output manifests.
